name: Abbazagorath
description: A fire dragon who collects the bronze bells of conquered towns. His scales are black as forge iron, and his voice carries for miles.
biography:
The first town to survive Abbazagorath sent its bellfounder up the mountain. She returned three days later with blistered hands and an agreement. Every autumn the town would cast a bell too heavy for six oxen to draw. As long as its note pleased him, the dragon would leave their roofs standing.

For eighty years the bells hung from iron hooks in his cavern. Then a young founder hid a flaw in the bronze. When Abbazagorath sounded his newest prize, it split from lip to crown. He flew down to punish the town and found cold hearths and empty streets. Now he follows the refugees from valley to valley. At dusk he lands outside each walled city and asks to hear its bells.
